grades.reason: Describes LoongArch LL.ACQ/SC.REL instructions, not the required RISC-V atomic operations.

grades.quote: If only the _aq_ bit is set, the atomic memory operation is treated as an _acquire_ access, i.e., no following memory operations on this RISC-V hart can be observed to take place before the acquire memory operation. If only the _rl_ bit is set, the atomic memory operation is treated as a _release_ access, i.e., the release memory operation cannot be observed to take place before any earlier memory operations on this RISC-V hart.
grades.reason: Directly explains the acquire and release ordering effects, with additional coverage of combined bits and address-domain scope.
Lists atomic instruction registers but provides no information about aq or rl.
Maps aq to acquire and rl to release, but does not explain their memory-ordering effects.
